input: I was charged twice for my subscription this month and need one of the charges refunded.
label: billing
reference: Confirm the duplicate charge, apologize, and explain a refund for the extra charge will be issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

input: The mobile app crashes every time I open the dashboard on Android 14.
label: technical
reference: Acknowledge the crash, ask for app version and a screenshot of the error, and share the known-issue workaround of clearing the app cache while a fix ships.

input: I need to update the email address and phone number on my account but settings won't save.
label: account
reference: Explain how to update contact details, and note that if the save button is greyed out it's usually an unverified pending change; offer to update it on their behalf after identity verification.

input: My API requests started returning 429 errors this morning even though I'm under my plan limit.
label: technical
reference: Explain 429 means rate limiting, point to per-minute (not just monthly) limits, and suggest exponential backoff plus checking the rate-limit headers.

input: Can you help me export all my invoices from last year as one PDF?
label: billing
reference: Point to Billing > Invoices > Export, explain the date-range filter and the combined-PDF option.

input: I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives. I checked spam already.
label: account
reference: Confirm the email on file, ask them to allowlist the sender, and offer to trigger a manual reset link after verification.

input: We want to switch from monthly to annual billing - will we be credited for the unused month?
label: billing
reference: Confirm the switch is possible mid-cycle and that unused time is prorated as a credit toward the annual plan.

input: What are your support hours and where are you headquartered?
label: other
reference: Provide support hours and headquarters location; keep it brief and friendly.

input: The inference endpoint latency spiked to several seconds during our demo - what happened?
label: technical
reference: Apologize, explain possible causes (cold start, regional routing, burst load), and offer to check logs for the time window if they share the request ids.

input: Please close my account and delete my saved payment method.
label: account
reference: Confirm the closure process, the data-deletion timeline, and that the payment method is removed immediately; ask for confirmation before proceeding.

input: I upgraded my plan but the new seats aren't showing for my team.
label: billing
reference: Confirm the upgrade, explain seats can take a few minutes to propagate, and offer to force a sync if they're still missing.

input: Single sign-on stopped working for our whole org after we rotated our SAML certificate.
label: technical
reference: Explain the new SAML cert must be re-uploaded in SSO settings, walk through where, and offer to validate the metadata.
